subject.title: Feishu: @mention not recognized in group when multiple bots share the same group (open_id app-scoped mismatch)

question: Which Feishu identity source should OpenClaw use to recognize a mentioned bot when WebSocket mention `open_id` values are scoped to a different app?
rationale: The source failure path is clear, but choosing between repairing the union-id candidate, collecting cross-app open_id aliases, or using another Feishu identity field requires maintainer intent and upstream API confidence.

options.title: Repair the linked PR
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/40782 as the candidate, resolve conflicts, and require proof that the selected identity field exists in real Feishu bot/group payloads.

options.title: Replace with alias design
options.body: Open a narrower replacement that maps known cross-app mention IDs without relying on unavailable bot `union_id` data, then close the dirty candidate after the replacement exists.

options.title: Document as unsupported
options.body: Leave require-mention behavior unchanged and document the Feishu multi-bot limitation until a stable identity contract is confirmed.

recommendation.title: Repair the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/40782 as the candidate, resolve conflicts, and require proof that the selected identity field exists in real Feishu bot/group payloads.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent Feishu identity-path history and already reviewed the linked PR as needing a current-main identity rewrite.
